Title: VNet Gateway Standard and High Performance Resource GUID changes

Body.Content:
Effective September 1, 2019, the resource GUIDs (also known as meter IDs) for Virtual Network Gateway standard and high performance will change.

There won’t be a pricing impact from this change, but you will need to modify billing routines before September 1, 2019 that rely on the resource GUID and names.

See the table below for the impacted resource GUIDs.
